name: Qu'aiti Sultanate
native: Qu'aiti State of Shihr and Mukalla

predecessors.name: Kathiri Sultanate
predecessors.text: Shihr and its district with Shibam

successors.name: People's Democratic Republic of Yemen
successors.text: coast to the Mahra border with Shabwa, the central valleys of Hadhramaut and the southern Empty Quarter

ledger.x: 1858: the Qu'aiti State of Shihr and Mukalla is established; Qu'aiti take Shibam from the Kathiri.
November 1881: the Jemadar is 'put in possession of Mukalla and its dependencies'; the full extent from coast to Mahra border and Shabwa is the page's undated description.
1967: overrun by communist forces, integrated into South Yemen in November.

certainty.note: No limits or area on the page.
